name: Microgrid storage charge-restoration scheduler
summary: Allocates the assigned battery recharge objective within the declared site and resource limits.
description: Allocates the assigned battery recharge objective within the declared site and resource limits. Storage coordination combines the battery's energy limits with the converter's electrical capability and the microgrid's operating demand. State of charge, allowable power and connection status describe different aspects of availability.

In a microgrid with a battery energy storage system, the controller can request discharge to support a power deficit while the battery management and conversion systems enforce their own operating limits. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Recharge target and available power” at the input and “Permitted recharge schedule” at the output. Charging priority must coordinate with site demand.
